## Today's signal

**Security** — Continued global attention on API-layer authorization flaws tracks with what we're seeing in East African fintech pentests: Broken Object Level Authorization remains the most common exploitable finding in production API reviews this quarter.

**Cloud** — Hybrid AWS/Azure adoption continues to be the dominant pattern among mid-market East African enterprises moving off single-provider setups, largely driven by data-residency and vendor-concentration risk rather than cost.

**Compliance** — Regulatory attention on cross-border data transfer safeguards continues across African data-protection jurisdictions; entities relying on foreign SaaS for regulated data categories should have documented contractual safeguards on file, not assumed adequacy.

**Regional** — Nairobi continues to anchor a disproportionate share of East African infrastructure investment relative to regional GDP share, consistent with the corridor's data-center and connectivity buildout over the past two years.
